title: Humanistic Exploration
subtitle: Constructivism applied to warmer, more human spaces — interiors and open landscapes.
seo_title: Constructivism Forms: Humanistic Exploration of Interiors and Abstract Landscapes
seo_description: A generative collection exploring constructivist forms across interiors and stylized landscapes with flowing curves, geometric rhythm, and vibrant color fields.
thumb_alt: Abstract forms and landscapes with geometric rhythm, interior vistas, and bold color fields.

media_alt: Constructivist forms in vibrant abstract scenes: interiors, flowing landscapes, and geometric arrangements with warm and cool palettes.
tiles: What its geometry does inside a lived space
challenge: Constructivism shows up most often in posters and graphic design, but I was curious what its way of thinking did inside quieter, more human subjects — an interior, a slow landscape. Could the same geometric eye make something that felt warm instead of stern?
approach: I kept reading about the movement and spent time with its lesser-known applications (interiors, stage design, softer work), then drafted many variations across interior and landscape scenes. I kept the six that felt structurally clear but also lived-in.
result: A set I enjoy — geometric, but warm enough to actually sit with. They're available as prints for anyone who likes that particular balance.
